assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, property ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering feasibility must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package is developed as a formal AI conceptual design submission based on provisional site package boundaries and submitted design layers; all statutory controls, official redlines, and engineering feasibility remain subject to official verification.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key area boundaries are provisional geometry provided in brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson.
assumptions.impact: Area metrics and spatial proportions are computed for design discussion and intake validation; they must be fully recalculated when official survey boundaries are released.

assumptions.statement: All renewal projects, spatial actions, suggested lead entities, and phasing schedules in the proposal represent AI-generated conceptual candidate options (Gated Candidates).
assumptions.impact: They do not constitute government project commitments or statutory approvals; implementation can only be assessed after professional verification, ownership coordination, and formal statutory approval.
